title: Rozedaro Ali pe Koofe
body:
Rozedaaron Ali pe kufe me ek aisa bhi waqt aaya hain..x6
<<MINI>>
Ibne muljim ne mere maula par..x2
Haaye sajde me zulm dhaya hain
Rozedaaron...x3

<<DIVIDER>>
Jiske baazu khuda ke baazu hain
Jiska chehra khuda ka chehra hain
Joke damade Mustafa logon
Jiski zauja Janabe Zahra hain
Yeh usi Murtaza ki mayyat hain
Jisne Islam ghar me pala hain

Rozedaaron..x4

Khud khuda ba hijab rehta hain
Yeh woh bibi hain jiski chaadar se
Aaj  baaki gilaafe kaba hain
Haye isi paak Sayyada Zainab
Ka yateemi ka waqt aaya hain
